:::{#rem-deriv-matrix-vector-special-case}
#### The derivative of a linear map as a special case

This result generalizes @thm-deriv-linear-map,
which is the special case $\vecf{v} = \vb$
(so that $q = p$, $\deriv{\vb} \vb = \matr{I}_p$,
and $\deriv{\vb} (\matr{A}\vb) = \matr{I}_p \tp{\matr{A}} = \tp{\matr{A}}$).
For example, @exm-deriv-linear-map is the case
$\matr{A} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 3 \end{pmatrix}$ and $\vecf{v} = \vb = \tp{(\beta_1, \beta_2)}$,
where this result gives $\matr{I}_2 \tp{\matr{A}} = \tp{(2, 3)}$.

:::
